## Context
Story: bd1d-4557-fb8f-43b5 — Phase G chunks Tier 2-7 bugs into ≤5 sub-branches in ci-pr mode

## Goal
Update plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md Phase G section to add ci-pr mode sub-branch chunking instructions (≤5-bug sub-branches, file-conflict splits, large-fix exception, serialized integration).

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md | modify | tests/scripts/test-debug-everything-phase-g-subbranch.sh | needs-modification |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Open plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md
2. Find Phase G section header (grep for '## Phase G')
3. Add a sub-branch instruction block at the PHASE G SECTION HEADER (not in a separate preamble) covering ci-pr mode:

   **Sub-branch creation (ci-pr mode only — when DEBUG_MODE=pr)**:
   
   In ci-pr mode, Phase G chunks Tier 2-7 bugs into sub-branches of at most 5 bugs each, preserving tier ordering:
   
   - Branch naming: bug-batch/<debug-session-id>/tier-<N>-batch-<K> (e.g., tier-3-batch-1, tier-3-batch-2)
   - Chunking algorithm: tier-first, then chunk each tier's bugs into groups of ≤5
   - File-conflict splits: when two bugs in the same tier-batch modify the same file, split them into separate sub-branches (still ≤5 per branch); splitting is iterative until no file conflicts remain within a batch
   - Large-fix exception: a single bug whose estimated diff exceeds 500 lines gets its own sub-branch with a -large suffix (e.g., tier-3-large); PRECEDENCE: large-fix exception wins over file-conflict split — a >500-line bug is routed to -large and removed from any file-conflict consideration
   - Serialized integration: the orchestrator MUST serialize sub-agent integration into the shared sub-branch ref — no concurrent push; dispatch one sub-agent at a time for integration, or use a lock mechanism. This prevents race conditions on shared refs.
   
   In local mode: commit directly to session branch.

4. Remove RED marker entries for test_phase_g_* from .test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- Phase G section header in SKILL.md contains sub-branch instructions
- SKILL.md references 'bug-batch/<debug-session-id>/tier-<N>-batch-<K>' naming pattern
- SKILL.md states 5-bug cap per sub-branch
- SKILL.md documents large-fix exception (>500 lines → -large suffix)
- SKILL.md states large-fix takes precedence over file-conflict split
- SKILL.md documents file-conflict splits → additional sub-branches
- SKILL.md states serialized integration (no concurrent push)
- RED markers for test_phase_g_* removed from .test-index
- All 7 structural tests in test-debug-everything-phase-g-subbranch.sh now PASS
- bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0 (or only other RED tests fail)
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
